g.text: 27-day synthetic lightcurves · 30-minute exposures · one shared grid of 2,455 periods
A40 / Xeon Gold 6342; medians of 3, ranges shown. Full API search, host to host. GTLS processes stars sequentially; CPU threads/workers tuned over 1, 4, 8.
Wide-window bounds and nominal epoch density are comparable, but templates, discrete grids and refinement differ.
Default-window v1.0 searches a narrower family. Recovery uses a 0.2% period tolerance; the timing injections alone do not establish completeness at fixed FPR.
